name: verticle-marquee
title: Vertical Marquee
blurb: Two-column vertical marquee with review cards scrolling in opposite directions.
description: Continuous testimonial scroll display with two columns of review cards moving vertically in opposite directions (20s duration each). Cards include avatar, name, username, and review text. Features pause-on-hover, noise texture overlay, and…
use_when: Social proof section requiring low-interaction vertical scrolling display of multiple testimonials.
avoid_when: When testimonials need to be dynamic — data is hardcoded and not props-configurable.
a11y: Cards are decorative review elements with no interactive elements. Continuous scroll never pauses beyond hover; no prefers-reduced-motion support.
